Gun Shop: Tidy Up is a relaxing cleaning simulator where you task yourself with bringing a massive gun shop into perfect order. Inside, chaos reigns, with over 2700 items scattered throughout the various rooms that you must find, collect, and return to their proper places. Gradually, empty spaces fill with neatly arranged items, and the clutter disappears before your eyes. If you want to download Gun Shop: Tidy Up Download via torrent on your PC and experience a relaxing gaming experience where the main pleasure is carefully searching and transforming a cluttered store into a perfect space.

Big cleaning

You'll have to explore the entire store, find scattered items, and determine exactly where each one needs to be returned. The sheer number of items constantly creates new small challenges, and attentiveness helps you navigate the many shelves and objects more quickly. As you work, the space gradually changes: randomly placed items give way to neat rows, and each cleared area becomes further evidence of the work accomplished.

To make finding and moving things easier, you can develop your character's stats. Improve your speed, inventory capacity, range, and stamina, and then unlock special abilities. Highlighting needed objects helps you spot them faster amidst clutter, pulling them together allows you to retrieve items that have been removed, and finding suitable shelves makes it easier to place them.
